Players buying gold from third-party websites that use bots to farm the game's primary currency has been a problem for the entirety of WoW's existence and has always been against the game's terms of service. What's changed is that developer Blizzard has made comments that it's looking to more aggressively punish gold buyers in Forever, even going as far to admit its been too "lenient" on the matter in the past. That more hardline stance against gold buyers was put to the test earlier this week when WoW: Forever streamer Ziqo was seen on stream accepting suspiciously large amounts of gold from strangers in the lead-up to a $100,000 prize pool PvP tournament he and many other streamers will be competing in. In a forum post seemingly issued in response to the Ziqo controversy, Blizzard stated that it would increasingly punish not only gold sellers, its standard practice, but also those buying the gold. In addition, accounts accepting large amounts of questionable gold could also be punished by having the illicit gold removed, their account suspended, or even permanently banned. Blizzard encouraged players not to accept "suspicious" transactions to avoid these consequences. gamespot.com/articles/the-street-fighter.title: The Street Fighter Movie’s Most Obscure Easter Egg Is For True Fighting Game Nerds
gamespot.com/articles/the-street-fighter.excerpt: Ahead of its release later this month, marketing for the Street Fighter movie has focused on deep references to the long-running fighting game series. How deep? We already knew that fighting game legend Justin Wong--alongside Michael "IFC Yipes" Mendoza--was making a cameo as one of the inmates who watches Ryu take on Blanka in a prison fight , but even his prisoner costume hides one heck of an Easter egg. Any fighting game fan will instantly recognize it: on Wong's neck, you can spot the number 37, a reference to the legendary Evo Moment 37 . In a new behind-the-scenes video, Wong detailed the time he spent on the Street Fighter movie set getting fake dirt and dressing up for his cameo. If you're unfamiliar with the significance of the fake 37 tattoo his character sports, it's a deep-cut nod to what many consider one of the greatest fighting game comebacks in history. Back in 2004, Wong faced off against Daigo Umehara, and with his chosen brawler, Chun-Li, down to just a sliver of health and backed into a corner, Wong parried over a dozen attacks from Umehara's Ken Masters and found the perfect window to counter the onslaught. https://youtu.be/ssipFrggf58 It's a moment that has yet to be equaled within the fighting game community, with the clip earning an obscene number of views over the decades. This is just the tip of the iceberg when it comes to the accuracy the Street Fighter movie is aiming for, as the film embraces the unique look of the Capcom games with its choice of costumes, special attacks, and goofy hairstyles that double as the perfect popcorn bucket . Chun-Li actress Callina Liang even went the extra mile to get into fighting shape for the movie, focusing on conditioning her thighs to look impressively muscular and memorizing Chun-Li's various attacks. gamespot.com/reviews/i-cannot-believe-si.title: I Can’t Believe A Silly Star Wars Racing Roguelite Is One Of My Favorite Games This Year
gamespot.com/reviews/i-cannot-believe-si.excerpt: I felt such a sense of whiplash jumping into Star Wars Galactic Racer after playing Zero Company . Unlike Zero Company--and plenty of the other Star Wars games we've gotten in recent years, like Survivor and Squadrons --Galactic Racer isn't trying to emulate the science-fantasy drama that defines the majority of the Star Wars movies and other assorted fiction. Instead, it's silly. We're not making morally gray decisions in a fight against an evil empire here. No, we're trying to win a racing league in order to dethrone the comically evil rich competitor mounting some kind of hostile takeover of the league. Oh, and we have an infinite number of chances to qualify, and protagonist Shade can walk away from the most violent of wrecks without a scratch. It's such a ludicrous situation that makes no sense if you think through the logistics of it for even a moment. And yet that very absurdity is exactly what racing in the Star Wars universe is all about. It sees competitors strapping themselves into barely functioning death machines to jockey against each other at breakneck speeds while soaring past lava, through narrow desert canyons, over acid-filled valleys, and alongside icy cliffs to the cheers and jeers of a bloodthirsty audience. Everything about the competition is comically ridiculous, and by leaning into that irrationality, Galactic Racer not only feels authentic to that fantasy, but it's also a hilariously good time. You race through the game as Shade, a former-racer-turned-cargo-pilot, who finds themselves brought back into the sport as both a favor to the league's commissioner and as a means of seeking revenge against Kestar Bool, an arrogant champion who wronged Shade in the past. Galactic Racer doesn't do too much to set up the stakes for this plot, framing Shade's revenge through a lens of a mystery. What did Kestar do to Shade? Why does Shade always wear a helmet? gamespot.com/articles/gta-6-should-blaze.title: GTA 6 Should “Blaze A Trail” To More Expensive Games, Dev Says
gamespot.com/articles/gta-6-should-blaze.excerpt: Rockstar's GTA 6 is priced at $80 for its standard edition. Another voice has come forward to say they hope other teams follow suit and charge more for new games to help the industry at a time when developers are closing up shop, cancelling games, and laying off developers on a regular basis. Martin Klima, the co-founder of Kingdom Come developer Warhorse, told PC Gamer that raising unit prices would "help a lot," but "everybody's scared to death" to do it. "Now, hopefully, GTA will blaze the trail, and it will allow us to increase the cost," he said, adding that Rockstar and Take-Two are among the only companies who can "afford, or who can dare" to raise prices in this way. He added that price increases for new games are "long overdue and also necessary for this business to survive." GTA 6 should kick off a trend of games costing more, Warhorse co-founder says. Take-Two was among the first big publishers to drive prices up from $60 to $70, kicking this off with NBA 2K21 in 2020. Numerous other publishers followed suit, and now $70 is the norm. Defending the price increase, Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick said production costs increased by 300%. Former PlayStation executive Shawn Layden said in 2025 that the price of new games should have gone up with every new console generation for the past 20 years. That largely did not happen, and now the industry is worse off for it, he said. “I think it’s because everyone’s afraid,” he told GI.biz . “No one wants to be the first one to raise the price, because you’re afraid to lose traffic. gamespot.com/articles/gta-6-takes-the-ri.title: GTA 6 Takes The Ridiculous World We Live In And Turns It Up To 11
gamespot.com/articles/gta-6-takes-the-ri.excerpt: Video games are usually a few steps removed from reality, but with Grand Theft Auto 6 , developer Rockstar Games aims to reflect and amplify the current state of the world with an "over the top" experience. As seen in the trailers and gameplay previews so far, GTA 6 is a contemporary game about doing whatever it takes to make it to the top, and that pursuit of fame and glory is often bookended by shootouts, car chases, and explosions in its Bonnie and Clyde narrative. "If you are going to put all this effort into creating a version of today’s world, it has to be more over the top, more insane, more in your face," senior VP of narrative Rupert Humphries said to Love Magazine . "Otherwise, you could just go outside and live in the real world." Humphries also described the world of GTA 6 as "a pressure cooker for all kinds of insanity," as the protagonists, Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval, are polar opposites. Game writer Elizabeth Gauvey-Kern described Lucina as an ambitious go-getter who'll do anything to get the life she dreams of, while Jason is bound by life's circumstances. "We wanted both protagonists to be vulnerable, tough, flawed, right sometimes, wrong sometimes, able to learn from each other," Gauvey-Kern said. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_vlzIPpyJR0 GTA 6 is also making some big changes to the franchise formula, as getting out of trouble won't be as easy as hiding in an alley and waiting for your wanted level to drop. Actions have consequences, and with the cops being much smarter and more persistent, players will have to be more cunning before they embark on a crime spree. The relationship between Jason and Lucia is also surprisingly more nuanced and deeper than you think, and it'll be a major part of the overall GTA 6 experience when the game launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. rockpapershotgun.com/desktop-and-handhel.excerpt: I don’t know if memory shortages have permanently killed off the concept of 'cheap' gaming PCs, but they have at least beat it into a coma. On the desktop side, inflated RAM, SSDs and graphics card prices continue to inflict karmic pain for our years of "It's cheaper to build it yourself" smugness, while formerly affordable handheld PCs are either suffering 40%-plus jackups or launching above £1K from the off. And the Steam Machine ! The poor, square Steam Machine . Every few weeks, possibly in denial, I’ll skim through the shops to see what budget games kit actually looks like in this day and age. Across the last five or six rounds, little has changed: the entry point into decent, more-or-less current-spec 1080p play remains stuck in the low quadruple figures, particularly if you’re fully new to PC ownership and need to factor in a monitor and peripherals. There is one exception, assuming you don’t fancy your luck on the secondhand market , but giving it a hands-on appraisal means confronting an ancient hardware foe of mine. gamespot.com/articles/stellar-blade-has-.excerpt: Despite some shortcomings, I have Stellar Blade to thank for reigniting my love of action games. I’m getting older with each passing year, and I need a good action fix every now and then to turn my brain off and enjoy slaying a variety of enemies. Stellar Blade delivers exactly that. If you’re like me, well, you won’t want to miss out on this great deal, with Stellar Blade cheaper than ever on PC. You play as Eve, who is sent alongside a group of super-soldier siblings down to a post-apocalyptic Earth to defeat the Naytibas. With humanity taking to space for safety, Eve’s goal is to defeat the powerful Alpha Naytibas and their leader, known as the Elder Naytiba, in the hope of saving what remains of humanity. Unsurprisingly, things go wrong fairly quickly. Stellar Blade manages to capture the same intensity of a hack-and-slash game while blending it with action-RPG elements that help it sit somewhere between the two genres. Narratively, it isn’t the strongest game out there, but its excellent combat helps it stand out as one of PlayStation’s most distinctive action games. And I’m thankful it managed to come to PC, too. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1fNcBiGiLY&pp=0gcJCS4MAYcqIYzv I’m, unsurprisingly, not the only one who likes it. In our Stellar Blade review , Imran Khan gave the game an 8/10, saying, “I came away from Stellar Blade having enjoyed the game quite a bit despite its foibles on the back of its incredibly strong systems.” If you’ve been looking for something to fill that Nier-sized hole in your heart, Stellar Blade may not be perfect, but it’s pretty damn good. Thankfully, there’s also a sequel coming, with Blood Rain being self-published by the developer this time around. Hopefully, that means we won’t have to wait for a PlayStation timed-exclusivity window to lapse and can instead enjoy it on PC at the same time as everyone else. rockpapershotgun.com/the-other-one-jorda.excerpt: Sometimes I Wonder About The Other Me is a 2D platformer created by "small game" developer Luis "Ludipe" Díaz Peralta, whose other works include A Place For The Unwilling . It's broken into a handful of single screen maps. On each screen, there's a Mario-brand exclamation mark block that burps a text fragment, forming an overarching monologue that begins with the title phrase. As you move between screens, you come to a signpost pointing left and right. Heading in either direction leads to a splitscreen area, with the player controlling duplicate characters. As you guide your charges rightward, one half of the screen flakes away to darkness. The remaining character returns to the starting screen, there to wonder anew about the Other Me. Read more

nintendolife.com/reviews/nintendo-switch.excerpt: Creepers, Skellies, oh my. A traditional adventure format seems an ill fit for something as freeform as Minecraft . The Markus 'Notch' Persson-created global phenomenon is an experience built on creativity with endless scope for experimentation, so constricting it within the boundaries of genre seems misguided. That said, the franchise has enough cultural pull that it drove audiences to brandish wild animals in movie theatres, so there is clear versatility in this IP. Minecraft Dungeons spun off from the main game in 2020 as a Diablo -like dungeon crawler brimming with character-building potential and co-operative fun for all ages. It boasts the polygonal art style and iconography beloved by fans, presenting a simple yet satisfying loot-based RPG experience. The sequel expands on this formula further by moving from episodic progression to open-world exploration and adding more depth to the basic combat and traversal loop. gamespot.com/articles/nba-2k25-is-gettin.title: NBA 2K25 Is Getting Delisted Soon, Single-Player Modes Also Closing Down
gamespot.com/articles/nba-2k25-is-gettin.excerpt: 2K Sports has announced that NBA 2K25 will be discontinued soon, and that includes delisting the product and server shutdowns that will make even the game's single-player MyCareer and MyTeam components unplayable. In a post , 2K Sports said NBA 2K25 will be removed from sale on October 30, 2026 and then fully discontinued on December 31, 2026. People who own the game can redownload it and play offline after the shutdown. However, as of January 1, 2026, all multiplayer games and access to every online mode will be removed. This means the single-player MyCareer and MyTeam modes will be unplayable, while players also won't be able to acquire any more virtual currency. As for what will be available after January 1, 2027, 2K Sports confirmed that Play Now, MyNBA, The W, and MyWNBA modes will remain. NBA 2K25 was released in October 2024, so it will have been fully online and full-featured for a period of about two years. The previous year's game, NBA 2K24, was discontinued on January 31, 2026 , with NBA 2K23 going dark a year prior to that . It's become something of a set schedule for the NBA 2K series to keep its servers up and operational for about two years. The impending closure for NBA 2K25--or any game--is a bummer for people who want to keep playing online, but this kind of thing is not uncommon in the world of sports games and beyond, for 2K and other publishers who shift resources to newer, more popular games over time. For a game like NBA 2K, there could also be licensing and legal requirements, too, given how many real-world people and brands appear in the games. People are particularly upset about only being able to play a mode like MyCareer for two years. They invest significant time into their teams, and two years just isn't enough for many people. gamespot.com/articles/10-new-things-we-j.excerpt: New information about Grand Theft Auto 6 continues to be revealed. Game Informer 's most recent issue included a number of new details, and we've rounded up some of the key things we learned below. Story Setup It seems like we'll start the game playing as Jason, since Lucia is still in prison. When Lucia gets out, the two get a score because they both want to live better, wealthier lives. It's supposed to be a simple job, but they get caught and an entire mystery that spans all of Leonida will unfold. The GTA 6 map is the biggest one Rockstar has ever made. Map Size While there has been a lot of speculation, leaks, and information around the internet about the GTA 6 map size, it's now been confirmed that Leonida in GTA 6 is twice the size of GTA 5. It's the largest map Rockstar has ever created by "some degree." It's difficult to fathom a bigger and more detailed world than Red Dead Redemption 2, but GTA 6 is about to deliver it. We're curious to see how all of the different areas of the map fit together to make one unified Leonida. The Main Regions The map is split into six different areas, and they are: Vice City, Leonida Quays, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and the Mount Kalaga National Park. Vice City is obviously based on Miami, and probably where you'll spend the most of your time. Grassrivers is GTA 6's version of the Everglades. Port Gellhorn, which represents smaller towns that double as tourist traps in Florida. Ambrosia is the "heart" of Leonida where a lot of factories and distilleries are, and we imagine there'll be plenty of seedy shootouts here. Mount Kalaga will have the off-road events, but also has some wealthier areas. Rideshare App The Rideshare app is called RydeMe. When you take one of these rideshares, you can chat with other NPCs and hang out, listen to music, and get from one point to another. gamespot.com/articles/resident-evil-stud.excerpt: Video games are the new battlefield for movie ideas , and after a reported bidding war , it appears Sony Pictures is the frontrunner to secure the rights to the Battlefield movie . The Wrap reported that Sony Pictures was in the lead position to win the rights, and The Hollywood Reporter backed this up. The Battlefield movie package reportedly includes Mission: Impossible director Christopher McQuarrie behind the camera, with Oscar-winner Michael B. Jordan in the mix to star and produce it. McQuarrie is also writing and producing. Universal, Netflix, Amazon MGM Studios, and Warner Bros. Discovery (now operating under Skydance) all reportedly submitted bids for the Battlefield movie. The Wrap said the dealmaking process is "shaping up to be the biggest bidding war of the year." The report did not mention any dollar numbers attached to the bids, or any other particulars, however. For example, if Netflix closes the deal, many might expect the film to be released on streaming instead of theatrically (but even at Netflix these days that's not a certainty). In the video game landscape, Battlefield and Call of Duty are rivals, and now they could become film foes, too. Skydance is making a Call of Duty movie , with Sicario's Taylor Sheridan writing and Lone Survivor's Peter Berg directing. The latest Battlefield game,  meanwhile, was 2025's Battlefield 6, which was the year's best-selling game overall in the US , surpassing Activision's Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. EA and Battlefield Studios will continue to support the game with more updates and new content into 2027 . In 2024, Battlefield boss Vince Zampella--who has since passed away--said EA had held discussions about a Battlefield movie or TV show already . A decade ago, Paramount bought the rights to make a Battlefield TV show , but it never materialized. gamespot.com/articles/love-and-deepspace.title: Love And Deepspace Devs Have One Simple Request: Please Don’t Drink The Poison
gamespot.com/articles/love-and-deepspace.excerpt: It hasn't been an easy year for the Love and Deepspace community after the Valko controversy left the fandom divided, but it looks like developer Papergames has brewed up new trouble for the gacha game. A few days ago, the developer posted cocktail recipes online, and followers quickly warned the studio that recreating those drinks could result in lethal concoctions. "One taste of this Special Blend and you won’t forget it," the original post read, which was accompanied by recipes for the non-alcoholic cocktail mixes. Each one is inspired by an in-game slime--Artsyblobbu, Fiendyblobbu, Pilotblobbu, Snowyblobbu, and Stellablobbu--and the list of ingredients includes several items found inside of Love and Deepspace. Cute, wholesome fun, right? Not exactly. https://twitter.com/Love_Deepspace/status/2104783385151656092 As people online pointed out , some of those ingredients include hallucinogens like Datura and other toxic elements like colchicine, which you definitely should not be consuming. Papergames released a follow-up post a day later. They stressed that the drink recipes posted above are "fictional" and for "in-game purposes" only. https://twitter.com/Love_Deepspace/status/2105330449132474515 The replies to the cocktail tweets have been just as toxic, with several Love and Deepspace players quickly hijacking the thread to demand that the hunky werewolf Valko be finally added to the game--which is an entirely different can of worms . Long story short: Think twice before you start mixing drinks from a video game social media account, as it pays to double-check the ingredients so that you don't harm your body or start tripping the light fantastic.

gamespot.com/articles/halloweens-first-d.title: Halloween’s First DLC Reveals Even The Bad Sequels Will Get Some Love
gamespot.com/articles/halloweens-first-d.excerpt: Halloween's first paid DLC is coming on October 27 in the form of a new skin for the game's killer, Michael Myers, and it's pulling from a source you might not expect: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers. A free update on the same day will also add a fifth map, The Tower Farm, inspired by a location in the same film. It may seem odd to jump to the fifth movie for the game's first DLC, but it's not the only piece of new content coming that day. There's also a second skin coming for Big Mike, borrowing from his look in the legacy sequel Halloween (2018). Each skin will run you $10. Survivor mains also have new things to look forward to, including two new characters, Michelle and Eugene, as well as Civilian Costumes Pack 1, which includes 14 outfits--one for each survivor character--and 42 colorings, or "tints." The new survivors will also go for $10, though that's for the pair, not for each of them, while the new styles and colors will be--you guessed it--$10 for the set. This content drop is the first of several coming to the game in its first year, development studio Illfonic said. With 13 movies in the series, there's still plenty of ground to cover for Halloween, which makes kicking off its post-launch roadmap with Halloween 5 such an interesting choice. The appropriately autumnal farm map is more open than the game's earlier maps, making it harder to break line of sight from Haddonfield's boogeyman. I suppose that moody setting was too picturesque to pass up as an update just days before October 31. Just days before Halloween, Halloween will look more like, uh, Halloween.
